name: Gimme's Par & Grill
address: 45 Ottawa Ave. NW, Grand Rapids, MI 49503

booking.howItWorks: Private events: send the "Host an Event" inquiry form on the website (name, email, phone, message). Bays: "Book a Bay" on the website. Tables: "Book a Table".

packages.name: Golf bay rental
packages.description: Hourly rental of a TrackMan simulator bay with a private table. Each bay holds up to 6 people. Three bays are also set up for other sports (cornhole, basketball, baseball, football) and games like zombie dodgeball.

packages.name: Private event
packages.description: Private events for corporate groups, birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties, rehearsal dinners, showers and more. Includes golf and other simulated games, food, and alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. Spaces include the main bar and restaurant and the upstairs simulator lounge. 20-guest minimum. Contact the venue for pricing.

faq.q: Can we bring outside food or drink?
faq.a: Outside food and drink are not allowed.

faq.q: Do I need a golf reservation to eat?
faq.a: No golf reservation is required to dine.
Walk-ins are welcome. Booking ahead is recommended for peak hours and weekends.

faq.q: How far ahead can I book?
faq.a: Bays can be booked up to 10 days ahead. Dining tables can be booked up to 30 days ahead.

faq.q: How many people fit in a bay?
faq.a: Each bay holds up to 6 people and has a private table. Groups of 6 or fewer per bay are recommended.

faq.q: Should I bring my own clubs?
faq.a: Bringing your own clubs is recommended.
Yes. The bays are left-handed friendly and the venue is kid-friendly.

faq.q: What is the minimum for a private event?
faq.a: Private events need at least 20 guests.
Memberships include club storage and one free hour per day in the bays.
Monday all day, Tuesday to Thursday 2 PM to 6 PM, and Friday 2 PM to 5 PM.
45 Ottawa Ave. NW, Grand Rapids, on the corner of Ottawa Avenue and Louis Street, downtown.
